Role: Foods ID Corporate Affairs Manager
Team: Foods Corporate Affairs Team
Reporting to: Greater Asia Corporate Affairs Director

Location: Jakarta, Indonesia
Start date: TBC

Earlier this year, Unilever announced an agreement to combine its Foods business with McCormick & Company, creating a scaled global flavour powerhouse. The proposed combination would bring together iconic Foods brands, including Hellmann’s and Knorr, with McCormick’s portfolio to create a global leader across spices, seasonings, condiments and complementary food categories, supported by strong retail and foodservice platforms. McCormick brings more than 135 years of heritage, a presence in 150+ countries and territories, and a portfolio of trusted brands. The transaction remains subject to regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions, with completion estimated for mid-2027.

Purpose of the Role

Lead the Corporate Affairs agenda for Indonesia, protecting and enhancing Foods' reputation through public affairs, trade association representation, stakeholder engagement, communications and issues management. The role supports business growth and transformation by ensuring effective engagement with policymakers, industry bodies, media, employees and other key stakeholders on critical food topics.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop and implement the Indonesia Corporate Affairs strategy, aligned to business priorities and global Corporate Affairs direction.
• Business partner with the GM/CEO Indonesia and Indonesia business leadership to identify, discuss and strategise on local issues, external risks and opportunities, ensuring Corporate Affairs is embedded in business decision-making.
• Build and maintain relationships with policymakers, trade associations, media and other key stakeholders, representing Foods in relevant forums and advancing advocacy on priority areas such as commodities import issues, nutrilevel, and salt-sugar-gat issues, as well as packaging, and responsible marketing.
• Monitor political, regulatory, media and stakeholder developments on critical food topics and assess implications for Foods and its reputation in Indonesia.
• Lead local issues management and reputation protection activities, ensuring emerging risks are identified and managed effectively.
• Lead local sustainability and/or community engagement programmes, ensuring consistent presences of the Foods brands in the communities.
• With Global Media Relations support, manage media enquiries, ensuring timely, accurate and aligned responses that protect and strengthen Foods' reputation.
• Support clear and consistent employee communications on business priorities, transformation and issues with local relevance.

EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

• Significant experience in Corporate Affairs, Communications and Public Affairs.
• Strong understanding of the Indonesian political, policy, regulatory, media and trade association landscape, particularly on priority food sector issues.
• Experience managing reputation, stakeholder engagement, communications, and sustainability and/or community engagement programmes within a complex organisation.
• Proven ability to represent business positions externally and work through trade associations to shape credible, evidence-based policy engagement.
• Excellent stakeholder management, influencing and relationship-building skills.
• Strong communication, presentation and writing capability in English and Bahasa Indonesia.
• Ability to operate effectively under pressure and manage sensitive issues with sound judgement.

MINDSET & BEHAVIOURS

Focus on What Counts

• Focuses the organisation on the external issues, narratives, public affairs priorities and stakeholder relationships that matter most to Foods in Indonesia.

Stay Three Steps Ahead

• Anticipates reputational risks and stays close to policy and regulatory developments, media trends and stakeholder expectations before they become business challenges.

Challenge & Debate on the Right Choices

• Brings thoughtful challenge to leadership discussions and shapes stronger external positioning.

Deliver with Excellence

• Ensures consistent, high-quality external communications and stakeholder engagement that strengthen trust and reputation.

WHAT SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

Within 24 months:

• Foods is recognised as a credible and trusted voice on priority food policy issues in Indonesia.
• Stakeholder engagement and advocacy support the successful delivery of business priorities.
• Reputation risks are anticipated and managed effectively.
• Indonesia leaders view Corporate Affairs as a valued strategic partner and trusted advisor.
• Communications and stakeholder engagement contribute positively to Foods' reputation, external relationships and employee understanding.

Job Purpose :
To provide actionable market, customer, and competitor insights that support strategic decision-making, enhance commercial performance, and strengthen the company's competitive positioning.

Main Responsibility :

• Analyze market trends, industry developments, and macroeconomic factors that may impact business performance and identify their implications for the organization.
• Conduct field surveys and market exploration to gather insights from relevant stakeholders, including RO Owners, customers, sales teams, and other business partners, to understand market conditions, customer needs, and business challenges.
• Monitor and analyze competitor strategies, products, offerings, campaigns, pricing, and go-to-market approaches, including benchmarking against internal products and market competitors.
• Develop a strong understanding of internal and competitor products, including product features, value propositions, pricing, and market positioning, to support comparative analysis and identify opportunities for improvement.
• Identify emerging market needs, customer behavior, industry trends, and potential business opportunities through both field research and analysis of internal and external data.
• Collect, validate, and analyze data from internal and external sources, combining quantitative data with field insights to generate meaningful business insights and actionable recommendations.
• Translate survey findings and market analysis into structured strategic reports and business recommendations for management, particularly for Regional General Managers (RGH) and Head of Sales (HOS).
• Provide data-driven insights and recommendations to support annual business planning, forecasting, performance reviews, and strategic decision-making.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders to validate findings, understand market dynamics, and ensure that recommendations are relevant to business needs.

Job Summary:**

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Procurement Administration Staff to support the procurement team at PT Japfa Food Indonesia. This role involves assisting with the administrative aspects of the purchasing process, ensuring efficient operations and accurate record-keeping.

Job Responsibilities:**

* Process purchase requisitions and purchase orders accurately and in a timely manner.
* Maintain and update vendor information, ensuring all data is current and complete.
* Communicate with suppliers to follow up on order status, delivery schedules, and resolve minor discrepancies.
* Assist in preparing and reviewing procurement documents, including contracts, invoices, and shipping documents.
* Organize and maintain procurement files, both physical and digital, ensuring easy retrieval and compliance.
* Support the procurement team in data entry, report generation, and analysis as required.
* Coordinate with internal departments (e.g., finance, warehouse) to ensure smooth procurement operations.
* Assist in identifying and resolving administrative issues related to the procurement process.
* Perform other administrative duties as assigned by the procurement manager.

Job Qualifications:**

* Minimum of a Diploma (D3) in Administration, Business Management, Supply Chain, or a related field.
* Proven experience (1-2 years) in an administrative role, preferably within a procurement or supply chain department.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) is essential.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills with a strong attention to detail.
* Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, in Bahasa Indonesia and English.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
* Proactive attitude with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
* Familiarity with procurement software or ERP systems is a plus.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming.
